Our tool uses MozJPEG, an advanced encoder developed by Mozilla that achieves better compression ratios than standard JPEG encoders while maintaining excellent visual quality. Key Fact: A typical high-resolution photo can be compressed by 60-80% without visible quality loss. This means faster page loads, easier sharing, and significant storage savings. Why Compress JPEG Images? Large image files create real problems across many use cases: Website Performance Images typically account for 50-70% of a webpage's total size. Unoptimized photos slow down page load times, hurt SEO rankings, and increase bounce rates. Google explicitly uses page speed as a ranking factor.
